verses.text: Then Eliphaz from Teman answered:
"Can a person be of any use to God? Even a wise person is only useful to himself.
Does it give the Almighty any pleasure if you are right? Does he gain anything if your life has no fault?
Is it because you respect him that he corrects you and brings you to court?
No, it is because your evil is great, and your sins have no end.
You took things from your relatives as a guarantee for loans, for no good reason. You took the clothes off people's backs and left them naked.
You did not give water to tired people or food to the hungry.
You were a powerful man who owned land, an honored man who lived in it.
You sent widows away with nothing and crushed the strength of orphans.
That is why traps are all around you, and sudden fear frightens you.
That is why it is so dark you cannot see, and a flood of water covers you.
Isn't God in the highest heavens? Look how high the farthest stars are!
Yet you say, 'What does God know? Can he judge through such deep darkness?
Thick clouds hide him, so he cannot see us as he walks around the dome of the sky.'
Will you keep to the old path that evil people have walked?
They were snatched away before their time. Their foundations were washed away by a flood.
They said to God, 'Leave us alone! What can the Almighty do to us?'
Yet it was God who filled their houses with good things. I want nothing to do with the plans of the wicked.
Good people see their ruin and are glad. The innocent laugh at them and say,
'Our enemies are destroyed, and fire has burned up what was left of their wealth.'
Get to know God and make peace with him. Then good things will come to you.
Accept the teaching from his mouth, and keep his words in your heart.
If you come back to the Almighty, you will be built up again. Remove evil far from your home.
Throw your gold into the dust, your best gold among the rocks in the streams.
Then the Almighty will be your gold and your precious silver.
Then you will find joy in the Almighty and lift up your face to God.
You will pray to him, and he will hear you, and you will keep your promises to him.
Whatever you decide to do will succeed, and light will shine on your path.
When people are brought low and you say, 'Lift them up,' God will save the humble.
He will even rescue someone who is guilty. He will be rescued because your hands are clean."
